CLM-PHOT-0133.statement: Focused ion beam cross-section scanning electron microscopy yields an estimated bonding gap width of 456 nm for a SESAM bonded to a glass substrate.

extra_quotes: An indium phosphide (InP)-based SESAM is bonded directly to the polished edge facet of a SiN PIC using a UV-curable epoxy

Because the bonding gap of the actual device cannot be measured without destroying it, we bonded a SESAM from the same batch to a glass substrate using identical assembly parameters and made a cross-section by focused ion beam (FIB) milling.
Measurements were performed at 1550 and 1560 nm, limited by the tuning range of the pulsed source.

The measured reflectivities remain below the simulated values. For the 500 nm tip at 1600 nm, the simulation predicts 77% for a fully saturated absorber without non-saturable loss, while 61% is measured for the unsaturated device.
